title: metastelma californicum subsp. lanceolatum
intro: Metastelma californicum subsp. lanceolatum, commonly known as California bugloss or bugloss vine, is a perennial vine native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, where its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Metastelma californicum subsp. lanceolatum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic, making it useful in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
